blocks.text: BMW Vinyl Wrap Bold Red Transformation

blocks.alt: Front view of an BMW displayed with vinyl wrap

blocks.html:
Our design team crafted a custom vinyl wrap for our client’s car, transforming a black BMW into a bold, attention-grabbing hot red car. Below are the project details showcasing this remarkable transformation.

Front view with a custom BMW vinyl wrap

BMW Vinyl Wrap Project Details

The designers used Wrap Authority as a guiding template for the project. They used a BMW i8 template and printed the design on a 1080 Series IJ 180 Printable Vinyl with Gloss Finish.

If you’re interested in personalizing your car, explore our custom car wraps.
